content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Cloudflare digital

Cloudflare R2 is an object storage service designed to provide developers with a simplified and cost-effective way to store and serve digital products. Unlike traditional platforms that impose significant fees on every transaction, R2 offers a pay-as-you-go model with no egress fees, which is particularly crucial for creators looking to maximize their profits. This means that when a digital product is sold, creators can deliver their goods without additional costs eating into their revenue. This level of control and cost efficiency is essential for digital entrepreneurs in restricted regions, allowing them to build sustainable online businesses without the burden of oppressive platform fees.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, Cloudflare R2 integrates seamlessly with other components of the COREMERCH infrastructure to create a robust digital commerce stack. Digital products are stored within R2, while Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle the backend logic for order processing. When a customer makes a purchase, NOWPayments automatically verifies the crypto payment, triggering a webhook that delivers the digital product from R2 directly to the buyer. This architecture not only simplifies the transaction process but also ensures that creators maintain full ownership of their data. The synergy between R2 and other stack components provides a resilient infrastructure that functions without reliance on third-party payment processors.
Who This Is Built For and Why

COREMERCH’s solutions are specifically designed for digital creators in countries where traditional payment systems fail to serve their needs. Whether you're an eBook author in Nigeria, a course instructor in Ghana, or a template designer in Venezuela, the infrastructure allows you to run your business without the constraints of platforms like Gumroad or PayPal. For these creators, operating on a platform that charges up to 10% per sale can cripple profitability. By utilizing Cloudflare R2 for storage and NOWPayments for payment processing, creators can significantly reduce costs, ensuring they keep more of what they earn and establish a truly sovereign commerce model.
Eliminate high platform fees and keep more of your profits.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The effectiveness of Cloudflare R2 as a digital product storage solution lies in its integration with other essential components of the COREMERCH stack. It starts with Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages for hosting the storefront, followed by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for processing backend logic. Supabase or Google Sheets serves as the order management database while NOWPayments facilitates seamless crypto transactions. Each component plays a vital role in ensuring that once a product is purchased, it is delivered instantly while maintaining an efficient workflow. This interconnected architecture empowers creators to operate independently, eliminating reliance on third-party platforms.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started with deploying your own sovereign digital commerce stack, first, visit the COREMERCH shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. Purchase the Complete Builder Kit, which provides you with all the blueprints and templates needed for implementation. Next, set up your Cloudflare account and deploy your storage on R2. Once your products are uploaded, configure your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing and ensure that your digital products are delivered automatically upon purchase. Finally, test your entire system to confirm that all components work together seamlessly before launching your store.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by utilizing a sovereign digital commerce stack that leverages Cloudflare R2 for storage and NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. This infrastructure enables you to deliver products directly to your customers while retaining full ownership of your data and profits. By avoiding traditional platform fees, such as the 10% charged by Gumroad, you can maintain higher margins on your sales.
Own your infrastructure, don’t rent it from third-party platforms.

Deploy your storefront using Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. 5. Write backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for order processing. 6.
